actual_conditions: Marathwada received 40-50% rainfall deficit during June-September 2023. Latur faced severe drought. 265 of 358 Maharashtra talukas declared drought-affected. Crops wilted in fields. Late rains could not recover standing crops.
actual_outcome: Soybean yield loss of 70-90% across Marathwada. State government initiated GPS-tagged panchnamas for crop damage assessment. Massive farmer distress reported.
what_icar_actually_recommended: ICAR Latur contingency plan recommended: short-duration soybean varieties (JS-335, JS-9305, MAUS-71), delayed sowing contingency with alternate crops, protective irrigation during critical flowering stage, raising seedlings in polythene bags for transplanting when moisture available.

actual_conditions: Beed district: approximately 4.84 lakh hectares of crop area damaged due to prolonged dry spells. Local committees estimated 70-100% loss for standing kharif crops. Severe moisture stress during vegetative growth.
actual_outcome: Cotton crop failed across large areas of Beed. Farmers reported near-total loss in rainfed areas. Heat stress caused flower shedding and boll drop.
what_icar_actually_recommended: ICAR Beed contingency plan: moisture stress management during vegetative stage — thinning, protective irrigation, mulching, interculture to conserve soil moisture, gap filling with same cultivar or pigeonpea.

actual_conditions: Vidarbha region including Yavatmal experienced 40%+ rainfall deficit. Delayed monsoon onset disrupted sowing schedules. Farmers who sowed early without sufficient moisture faced germination failure.
actual_outcome: Significant re-sowing was required in cotton areas. Yield losses of 50-80% reported in rainfed cotton. Pest incidence (pink bollworm) increased due to crop stress.
what_icar_actually_recommended: ICAR Yavatmal contingency plan: delay sowing until adequate moisture, use recommended Bt cotton varieties, seed treatment, avoid early sowing without sufficient rainfall, pest management protocols for stressed crops.

actual_conditions: Amravati district in Vidarbha experienced severe mid-season drought during the critical flowering stage of soybean. Prolonged dry spells of 15-20 days during July-August devastated flowering and pod formation.
actual_outcome: Soybean yields dropped 60-80% in rainfed areas. Flower dropping and pod abortion due to moisture stress. Farmers who applied protective irrigation had 30-40% better yields than those who didn't.
what_icar_actually_recommended: ICAR Amravati contingency: protective irrigation during flowering, foliar spray of 2% urea or KNO3 to reduce flower drop, avoid top dressing fertilizer without soil moisture, hormonal spray NAA 20ppm to prevent flower drop.

actual_conditions: Post-El Niño transition period. Residual moisture deficit from 2023 drought affected rabi and early kharif 2024 crops. Groundwater levels significantly depleted in Latur.
actual_outcome: Tur (pigeon pea) showed moderate recovery due to better late-season rains. However, wilt disease incidence was higher due to weakened plants from previous season's drought stress.
what_icar_actually_recommended: ICAR Latur contingency: intercultivation for moisture conservation, wilt-resistant tur varieties, protective irrigation during dry spells, nutrient management adjusted for soil moisture availability.
